info.name: NCBI Entrez E-utilities History Retrieval API

params.name: db
params.description: Database from which to retrieve records (e.g., pubmed, nucleotide, protein, gene).

params.name: id
params.description: Comma-delimited list of UIDs to retrieve.

params.name: retstart
params.description: Sequential index of the first record to retrieve (default: 0).

params.name: retmax
params.description: Number of records to retrieve (default: 20, max: 10000).

params.name: rettype
params.description: Retrieval type. For PubMed: abstract, medline, uilist, docsum. For sequences: fasta, gb, gp.

params.name: retmode
params.description: Retrieval mode. Values: xml, text, asn.1.

params.name: WebEnv
params.description: Web environment string from a previous ESearch, EPost, or ELink call.

params.name: query_key
params.description: Integer query key from a previous ESearch, EPost, or ELink call.

params.name: tool
params.description: Name of application making the call (no spaces). Recommended.

params.name: api_key
params.description: API key to enable up to 10 requests/second.

items.docs: Retrieves full records in a specified format for a list of input UIDs from an Entrez database. Supports multiple return types and modes depending on the target database.
